name: Curated Floral Archive Carousel Tab Selection

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the '#gallery' section with the title 'Haute Floral Archive'.
Verify the gallery carousel is visible and displays floral stories with interactive tabs.
Click on the carousel tab labeled 'Story 2' or id 'carousel-tab-1'.
Verify the active story card transitions to display 'Single-Origin French Peonies' or author 'Antoine Laurent'.
